@notesPage: row label in the assignment and event sheets: the full page of notes that belongs to the item

@details: heading over a group of an event's or course's details (course, color, location; teacher, email, room)

created.@now: footer of an assignment or event made less than a minute ago
created.@relative: footer of an assignment or event; {when} is a time relative to now, like “3 days ago” or “yesterday”
created.@date: footer of an assignment or event; {date} is the date it was made, like “Oct 20, 2025”

coursePicker.@noCourse: menu item in the course picker: the item belongs to no course

assignment.label: Assignment

assignment.@status: row label for an assignment's status (to do, in progress, done)

assignment.@statusDone: an assignment's status: finished (an adjective, not a button)
assignment.@priority: row label for how important an assignment is
assignment.@grade: heading over an assignment's score and grade category
assignment.@score: row label for the points an assignment earned
assignment.scoreHint: Points earned out of points possible
assignment.@category: row label for an assignment's grade category (Homework, Exams…)
assignment.@weightedIn: under the Category label when the course weighs its categories; {course} is the course's name
assignment.@weightedInCourse: the same, for a course with no name
assignment.@noCategory: shown on the category picker button when the assignment has no grade category
assignment.@noCategoryItem: menu item in the category picker: the assignment has no grade category

assignment.@add: button that adds the new assignment
assignment.@dropToAttach: shown over the sheet while files are dragged onto it

event.label: Event
event.@label: accessible name of the sheet that edits a calendar event
event.@newLabel: accessible name of the sheet that makes a new calendar event
event.@defaultTitle: the title an event is saved with when it's added without one
event.@titlePlaceholder: placeholder in the title box of a new event
event.@thisEvent: choice: changes made apply to this one session of a repeating event
event.@allEvents: choice: changes made apply to every session of a repeating event
event.@editScope: row label above the choice of which events of a repeating series to change (This Event or All Events)
event.@editScopeLabel: accessible name of the This Event / All Events choice
event.@onlyDate: under the Edit label when only one session is being changed; {date} is that session's date, like “Monday, Oct 14”
event.@allDay: row label and switch: the event takes the whole day, with no times
event.@starts: row label for when an event starts
event.@ends: row label for when an event ends
event.@repeat: row label for how often an event repeats (a noun)
event.@repeatUntilTip: tooltip of the date the repeats stop on
event.@repeatUntil: accessible name of the date the repeats stop on
event.@courseColor: the color swatch that uses the event's course color
event.@accentColor: the color swatch that uses the app's accent color (the event has no course)
event.@location: row label for where an event takes place
event.@notesPlaceholder: placeholder in an event's notes box: examples of what goes there
event.@notesFor: row label for the notes page of one class session; {date} is its date, like “Mon, Oct 14”
event.sessionNotesNone: A dated page for this class
event.@seriesNotesPage: row label for the notes page of a whole repeating event

event.@changedSeparately: footer of one session of a repeating event that was changed on its own

capture.title: Quick Capture
capture.@title: title of the small window for jotting down a note or to-do quickly
capture.footer: Notes and to-dos go to your Inbox page.
capture.@footer: “Inbox” is the name of the page they go to: use the same name as that page's title

import.title: Import Calendar
import.@title: title of the window that previews a calendar (.ics) file before importing it
import.@include: accessible name of the checkbox beside each entry; {title} is the entry's title
import.@firstOnly: tag on an entry whose repeat can't be shown: only its first occurrence is imported
import.firstOnlyTip: This repeat is more than Thought Desk can show; only the first one comes in
import.@firstOnlyTip: “Thought Desk” is the app's name: keep it as it is
import.@update: tag on an entry imported before: importing it again updates it
import.updateTip: Imported before; it will be updated
import.@importAs: accessible name of the Event / Assignment choice for each entry
import.@asEvent: choice: import the entry as a calendar event
import.@asAssignment: choice: import the entry as an assignment (homework or other school work)
import.@selected: footer: {count} entries are ticked out of {total} in the file
import.@selectedUpdates: footer: {count} entries are ticked out of {total}; {updates} of them were imported before
import.@selectedSimplified: footer: {count} entries are ticked out of {total}; {simplified} of them repeat in a way the app can't show, so only their first occurrence comes in
import.@selectedUpdatesSimplified: footer: {count} entries are ticked out of {total}; {updates} were imported before; {simplified} repeat in a way the app can't show
import.@run: button that imports the ticked entries; {count} is how many
import.@added: message after an import: {count} new items were added
import.@updated: message after an import: {count} items imported before were updated
import.@addedUpdated: message after an import: {count} new items were added and {updated} imported before were updated
import.@nothing: message after an import that added and updated nothing

import.@noEvents: error: {name} is the name of the calendar file that was chosen

courseView.@classesThisWeek: under a course's name; {count} is how many of its classes are in the next seven days
courseView.@openAssignments: under a course's name; {count} is how many of its assignments aren't done yet
courseView.@teacher: label of the course's teacher's name
courseView.@teacherPlaceholder: placeholder in the teacher's name box
courseView.@email: label of the teacher's email address
courseView.@emailPlaceholder: placeholder in the email address box
courseView.@officeHours: label of when the teacher can be seen outside class
courseView.@officeHoursPlaceholder: placeholder in the office hours box
courseView.@room: label of the room the course is taught in
courseView.@renameTitle: title of the box that asks for a course's new name
courseView.@openFolder: menu command that opens the page holding the course's notes
courseView.@createFolder: menu command that makes the page holding the course's notes
courseView.@options: tooltip of the button that opens the course's menu
courseView.@newAssignment: button with a plus that adds a new assignment to this course
courseView.@flashcards: tooltip of the Study button; {count} is how many flashcards there are in all the decks in the course's notes
courseView.@study: button that starts studying the course's flashcards; {count} is how many cards are ready to study now (due for review or new); with none, it studies them all
courseView.@upNext: heading over a course's next classes and events
courseView.@addClass: button that adds a class (an event) to the course
courseView.noClasses: No classes in the next two weeks

courseView.@doneCount: beside the Assignments heading; {count} is how many of the course's assignments are finished
courseView.@nothingOpen: shown when none of the course's assignments is still to do

courseView.@grades: heading over a course's grade and its grade categories

courseView.@newCategoryTitle: title of the box that asks for a new grade category's name
courseView.@gradedWeighted: under Current grade: {count} assignments have scores, and the categories count by their weights
courseView.@gradedByPoints: under Current grade: {count} assignments have scores, and the grade is total points earned over points possible
courseView.@noScores: under Current grade when no assignment has a score yet
courseView.@uncategorized: the grade category of assignments that have none
courseView.notCounted: Not counted: give it a weight
courseView.@notCounted: under a grade category that has scores but no weight, so it doesn't count toward the grade
courseView.@weightTip: tooltip of a grade category's weight box (a percentage)
courseView.@weightLabel: accessible name of a grade category's weight box; {category} is the category's name
courseView.@removeWeight: tooltip of the button that removes a grade category's weight
courseView.@removeCategory: accessible name of the same button; {category} is the grade category's name
courseView.weightsSum: Weights add up to {total}; the grade is scaled to fit.
courseView.@weightsSum: shown when the category weights don't add up to 100%; {total} is their sum, like “90%”

courseView.noNotesText: Take Notes in class and each lecture lands here, dated.

courseView.@allNotes: link to the course's notes folder, shown when it has more than 8 notes; {count} is how many
courseView.deletedText: Its assignments, events and notes are still in their places.

section.@pages: heading over a list of pages

section.@events: heading over a list of calendar events
